title: sarcolobus peregrinus
intro: Sarcolobus peregrinus, commonly known as the Indian spikenard, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of India and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Sarcolobus peregrinus are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
